method:
Read only the plan data (p0/sukhumvit prims.pkl and DXF-derived items) and the two tools. Did not look at other labellers' work, detector output or pipeline door data.

Steps:
1) Overview render of x 7-32, y 5-26.2 (grid 1, inserts, and a second one with text).
2) Sixteen tiles of about 6.5 x 6 m at grid 0.5 with inserts, 2000 px: x 7-13.5 / 13-19.5 / 19-25.5 / 25.5-32 by y 5-11 / 10-16 / 15-21 / 20.2-26.2.
3) Close-ups: corridor (12.5-15.5 x 15.5-19.8), living/dining partition (26.2-27.4 x 14.2-21.6), south facades (19-26 and 26-33 x 13.9-15.1), and spa plus bathroom (7.5-15.2 x 7.2-16.2). One context render of x 24-54.5 for orientation only.

Geometry first:
- Scripted a scan of every WALL/COL axis-aligned line for collinear wall-line ends facing each other (gaps of 0.3-6 m).
- Listed all DOOR and JAMB inserts. Fitted the centres and radii of every arc, including the layer-0 leaves and swings at the north door and the pivot door.
- Listed all WIN, WALL-GL, HATCH, TREE and FLOOR lines, including the nested window blocks hjkhkk (inserted twice) and jkljlll.
- Checked every other block in the box; all of them are furniture.
- Classified each gap, then checked every candidate on the tiles.

Measurement:
- a and b are at the structural faces: WALL/COL ends, or the outer edges of the JAMB pair where wall lines run through (GW-08).
- The 50 mm D-JAMB cladding on the living-room piers is excluded and noted where it matters.
- Centre line is the middle of the wall. The facade walls are 0.25 m on the grid lines; this was read from the TREE/FLOOR outer-face lines, with window frames flush to the inner face.
- Heights were not read. Kinds for glazing come from plan cues (tracks, slide arrows, furniture, planters, deck), with low confidence where the plan cannot tell.

Verification: drew all a-b segments over the plan (ov_westwing_v2, ov_pavilion_v2) and made final --mark renders (final_marks_all/west/east). Nothing was left unmarked except the items listed as glass walls, rejected or uncertain.

Totals: 23 openings (8 doors, 10 windows, 5 passages) and 3 glass-wall segments.
